text: “This young lady loves you with an H,” the King said, introducing Alice in the hope of turning off the Messenger’s attention from himself—but it was no use—the Anglo-Saxon attitudes only got more extraordinary every moment, while the great eyes rolled wildly from side to side. “You alarm me!” said the King. “I feel faint—Give me a ham sandwich!” On which the Messenger, to Alice’s great amusement, opened a bag that hung round his neck, and handed a sandwich to the King, who devoured it greedily. “Another sandwich!” said the King. “There’s nothing but hay left now,” the Messenger said, peeping into the bag.
